note: The graph steps fail if graph draws an unheld group under holdings (the group path in graph.rs) instead of refusing it, or focuses a node for a group in reference. The variable steps fail if a held variable whose group member rows are all unheld names that group under holdings, in show (sending the webapp to a group page with no lane for it), schema or graph (group_key or schema's group column ignoring member_in_scope). The search steps fail if a holdings search returns the group hit (its label or its folded members ignoring member_in_scope) instead of the held variable, or if the reference twin stops returning the group.
